# Load shared monthly QC settings

settings_rmd <- "C:/Users/klynoe/Documents/misc_R/qc_loaders/monthly_qc_plot_settings.rmd"

# Check that the file exists
if (!file.exists(settings_rmd)) {
  stop("Settings Rmd file not found: ", settings_rmd)
}

# Extract the R code from the Rmd
settings_r <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")

knitr::purl(
  settings_rmd,
  output = settings_r,
  quiet = TRUE
)
## [1] "C:\\Users\\klynoe\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\RtmpSoDIY5\\filec5b442b27e6b.R"
# Load the shared plotting functions
source(settings_r, local = .GlobalEnv)

# Remove temporary extracted file
unlink(settings_r)

# Confirm that the plotting functions loaded
stopifnot(
  exists("plot_flux", mode = "function"),
  exists("plot_flux_single", mode = "function"),
  exists("plot_week_flux", mode = "function"),
  exists("plot_biweek_flux", mode = "function")
)

message("Monthly QC settings loaded successfully.")

# SLUMP SENSORS

SLUMP SINGLE SOIL TEMP

PS_soilT <- plot_flux_long(
  df_month,
  cols = c("TS_2_38_2_1_1.c",
           "TS_2_38_3_1_1.c",
           "TS_2_38_4_1_1.c"),
   labels = c(
    "Bare Soil",
    "Floating Veg.",
    "Dense Veg."
  ),
   colors = c(
     "brown",
    "turquoise4",
    "green4"
  ),
  y_label = "Soil Temperature (°C)",
  title = "Slump Soil Temperature - 10 cm",
  site = "Toolik",
  date_breaks = "2 days",
  date_labels = "%b %d")

PS_soilT
